summary: Iteration 12: Comprehensive testing of Withdrawal PIN flow + Nomba transaction verification (no webhook). 20/20 backend pytest tests PASSED. Frontend e2e via Playwright: admin AdminWithdrawals + user Profile PIN card + Withdraw page all working correctly.

issues: When user has neither bank nor PIN, only the bank-missing-warn banner is shown — the no-pin-banner is hidden behind `bankReady && !hasPin`. The PIN input placeholder ('Set PIN on Profile first') and disabled submit button still convey the requirement, but the explicit 'Set my PIN' banner with link to /profile only appears after bank is added. Minor UX concern; not a functional bug.

action_items: (optional UX) Consider showing the no-pin-banner regardless of bankReady state so users see both onboarding requirements at once, OR add inline PIN hint inside the bank-missing-warn.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.py pay-nomba: pre-flight balance check only triggers when `available is not None`. If nomba_balance() raises, balance_err is set but never raised — the code then proceeds to transfer_to_bank, which will fail if float is truly insufficient but auth succeeded. Consider raising 503 when balance check itself errored OR adding a strict mode setting.

routes_user.py withdraw flow: PIN lockout check uses `datetime.fromisoformat(locked.replace('Z','+00:00'))` but the stored value is already an ISO string with offset; this works but may double-replace and silently swallow exceptions via the bare `except Exception: pass`. Lockout failure mode could let a locked user through if isoformat parsing breaks — recommend explicit logging.
Profile.jsx: set-pin-input uses inputMode='numeric' but no `maxLength={4}` constraint — the API rejects, so it's just UX polish.
Withdraw.jsx no-pin-banner gated by `bankReady` — see design_issues above.
